facts.text: get_exposure returns the exposure in microseconds and set_exposure takes microseconds
get_gain returns the analogue gain multiplied by 100 on the Picamera2 backend
get_ae_enabled is Picamera2 only and returns False for the other backends
get_hqi returns the High Quality Image mode of the Player One backend
The USB bandwidth limit is a percentage in the range 35 to 100
get_offset returns the sensor black-level offset
get_sensor_mode_index returns -1 when the camera has no mode selection
reset_capture_stats zeroes the get_raw_frame failure counters and get_capture_stats returns lock_timeout and sdk_timeout_or_error
get_dropped_frames_count is the SDK dropped-frame count and resets on stop
get_supported_resolutions returns the standard resolution list plus the native resolution
stop sets running to false and releases the active camera backend
With no backend argument the constructor auto-detects PlayerOne, then Picamera2, then OpenCV
